ImageDescription.value:
Handwritten letter of Guru Gobind Singh and his scribe. "Signatures of Guru Gobind Singh Sahib on the Hukumnama to Bhai Triloka and Bhai Rama from the family of Phul - also known as the Patiala Hukumnama-includes the line 'Tera ghar mera assey' - later used as the 'Motto' on the crest of the Patiala Maharajas (2 August 1696)." (quote taken from Patshahi10.com

<hr>

Meaning of the word "nishan" (Punjabi ਨੀਸਾਣੁ neeshaaṇ meaning sign, mark, insignia of approval, spelled in Gurbani as ਨੀਸਾਣੁ, and colloquially as ਨਿਸ਼ਾਨ): nishan/nisan/neeshan, a signature/autograph of the Sikh gurus or other prominent Sikhs, often by scribing the Mul Mantar [perhaps as some sort of authentication measure of the specific manuscript it is written in] but not always being the Mul Mantar.)

2) http://patshahi10.com/glimpse-of-bani-written-in-guru-gobind-singh-sahibs-own-handwriting (page four)

Artist.value: Guru Gobind Singh and his scribe
